results.title: Officially the fifth signing: Paris strikes hard in the transfer market
results.description: European teams must be careful Paris Saint-Germain have officially confirmed the signing of Belgian forward Mika Godts from Ajax Amsterdam. He becomes the club's third attacking reinforcement of the summer and their fifth arrival overall, a fresh boost to Luis Enrique's options ahead of the new season.

results.title: Trabzonspor pegged back by Kasimpasa as Salah makes debut
results.description: Egypt winger Mohamed Salah made his first appearance for Trabzonspor as they were held to a 1-1 draw by Kasımpaşa in their Turkish Super Lig opener on Saturday.
